notes: Transcribed from the PWD Schedule of Rates 2022 (Revised), Part A: Civil Works (16th edition, revised, effective 23 February 2023) on 2026-10-21. The four official price zones (Dhaka and Mymensingh / Chattogram and Sylhet / Khulna, Barisal and Gopalgonj / Rajshahi and Rangpur) become each line's regional multipliers. These are works rates: the contractor's profit, overhead and VAT are listed separately in the book and are not included. Stone chips added 2026-11-09 from the same copy (hash checked). Formwork (steel, per sqm) and rebar fixing (derived) added 2026-11-09; the book has no man-day norms, it prices works as composite rates. A candidate card until a human marks it active. Updated 2026-11-13: material prices (cement, TMT rod, sand, stone chips, brick) and labour and machinery where a 2026 source was found now use 2026 market values, each line notes its source. Lines still on SoR 2022 values are marked NOT UPDATED in their note. The card is still a candidate until a human marks it active.
